Test_Description: Verify default/reset values of all GPIO per-pin registers (gp0_gpio_8/9/10) after hardware reset. Read each register and compare against expected reset value from spec.
Register_Fields: data_in, intr_raw_sts, intr_clr, pedge_intr_en, nedge_intr_en, level_sel, io_ctrl, dout
Access_Type: RO, RO, WO, RW, RW, RW, RW2, RW2
Pre_Conditions:
1. System is powered on and hreset_n is deasserted.
2. No prior writes to GPIO registers.
3. GPIO0 instance is selected (#define GPIO0 1).
Test_Steps:
1. Apply hardware reset (assert and deassert hreset_n).
2. Read register gp0_gpio_8 at base+0x0.
3. Compare read value (masked with read_mask & 0xFFFFFFFE) against default value 0x00100000.
4. Read register gp0_gpio_9 at base+0x4.
5. Compare read value against default value 0x00100000.
6. Read register gp0_gpio_10 at base+0x8.
7. Compare read value against default value 0x00100000.
Expected_Result: All three registers return their expected default/reset values after hardware reset.
Pass_Criteria: Read values match expected default values for all registers with zero def_fail_cnt.
Macro_Define: MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 (base=0xA001A000 offset=0x0), MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_9 (base=0xA001A000 offset=0x4), MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_10 (base=0xA001A000 offset=0x8)

3. Write 0xFFFFFFFF masked with write_mask to gp0_gpio_10.
4. Read back gp0_gpio_8 and compare with expected value (0xFFFFFFFF & read_mask & write_mask) | (non-writable bits & default).
5. Read back gp0_gpio_9 and compare.
6. Read back gp0_gpio_10 and compare.
Expected_Result: Read-back values match expected computed values for all three registers.
Pass_Criteria: Read values equal expected values with zero wr_fail_cnt.

Test_Description: Verify that read-only fields (data_in bit[0] and intr_raw_sts bit[1]) in gp0_gpio_8/9/10 cannot be modified by write operations.
Pre_Conditions:
1. System is powered on and hreset_n is deasserted.
2. GPIO0 instance is selected.
Test_Steps:
1. Read default value of gp0_gpio_8 data_in field (bit 0).
2. Write 0xFFFFFFFF to gp0_gpio_8.
3. Read back gp0_gpio_8 and verify data_in (bit 0) and intr_raw_sts (bit 1) are unchanged.
4. Repeat for gp0_gpio_9 and gp0_gpio_10.
Expected_Result: Read-only fields data_in and intr_raw_sts remain unchanged after write operations.
Pass_Criteria: RO fields retain their hardware-driven values regardless of software writes.

Test_Description: Verify io_ctrl field (bit[20]) in per-pin registers controls GPIO direction. Default value is 1 (input mode). Write 0 to set output mode and read back.
Pre_Conditions:
1. System is powered on and hreset_n is deasserted.
2. GPIO0 instance is selected.
Test_Steps:
1. Read gp0_gpio_8 and verify io_ctrl (bit 20) is 1 (input mode default).
2. Write 0 to io_ctrl field of gp0_gpio_8 to set output mode.
3. Read back and verify io_ctrl is 0.
4. Write 1 to io_ctrl to restore input mode.
5. Read back and verify io_ctrl is 1.
6. Repeat for gp0_gpio_9 and gp0_gpio_10.
Expected_Result: io_ctrl field toggles correctly between input mode (1) and output mode (0).
Pass_Criteria: io_ctrl field reads back the written value correctly for all three registers.

Test_Description: Verify dout field (bit[21]) in per-pin registers can be written and read back. This field controls the output data value when GPIO is in output mode.
Pre_Conditions:
1. System is powered on and hreset_n is deasserted.
2. GPIO0 instance is selected.
3. io_ctrl set to 0 (output mode).
Test_Steps:
1. Set io_ctrl to 0 (output mode) for gp0_gpio_8.
2. Write 1 to dout field (bit 21) of gp0_gpio_8.
3. Read back and verify dout is 1.
4. Write 0 to dout field.
5. Read back and verify dout is 0.
6. Repeat for gp0_gpio_9 and gp0_gpio_10.
Expected_Result: dout field toggles correctly between 0 and 1.
Pass_Criteria: dout field reads back the written value correctly for all three registers.

Test_Description: Verify interrupt configuration fields (pedge_intr_en nedge_intr_en level_sel) in per-pin registers can be independently set and cleared.
Pre_Conditions:
1. System is powered on and hreset_n is deasserted.
2. GPIO0 instance is selected.
Test_Steps:
1. Read gp0_gpio_8 and verify pedge_intr_en (bit 17) nedge_intr_en (bit 18) level_sel (bit 19) are all 0.
2. Write 1 to pedge_intr_en only. Read back and verify only bit 17 is set.
3. Write 1 to nedge_intr_en only. Read back and verify only bit 18 is set.
4. Write 1 to level_sel only. Read back and verify only bit 19 is set.
5. Clear all interrupt config fields. Read back and verify all are 0.
6. Repeat for gp0_gpio_9 and gp0_gpio_10.
Expected_Result: Each interrupt configuration field can be independently set and cleared without affecting other fields.
Pass_Criteria: Individual interrupt config bits read back correctly after each write operation.

Test_Description: Verify intr_clr field (bit[16]) is write-only. Writing 1 should clear interrupt raw status. Reading should return 0.
Pre_Conditions:
1. System is powered on and hreset_n is deasserted.
2. GPIO0 instance is selected.
Test_Steps:
1. Read gp0_gpio_8 bit 16 (intr_clr). Verify it reads as 0 (WO field).
2. Write 1 to bit 16 of gp0_gpio_8.
3. Read back gp0_gpio_8 bit 16. Verify it still reads as 0 (write-only).
4. Repeat for gp0_gpio_9 and gp0_gpio_10.
Expected_Result: intr_clr field always reads as 0 regardless of write value confirming write-only behavior.
Pass_Criteria: Bit 16 reads 0 before and after write operations for all three registers.

Test_Description: Verify that VRRW-type group registers are correctly identified and skipped during standard write-read testing as per skip_array configuration.
Register_Fields: G8_intr_raw_stclr through G39_intr_raw_stclr, G8_io_ctrl through G15_io_ctrl, G8_dout through G15_dout, G8_din through G15_din
Pre_Conditions:
1. System is powered on and hreset_n is deasserted.
2. GPIO0 instance is selected.
3. skip_array and skip_rst_array are configured.
Test_Steps:
1. Verify skip_array entries for VRRW registers are set to 1.
2. Execute write-read test loop.
3. Confirm VRRW registers at offsets 0x80 0x94 0xA4 0xB4 are skipped.
4. Verify no write-read errors reported for skipped registers.
Expected_Result: VRRW registers are correctly skipped during write-read testing and no false failures are reported.
Pass_Criteria: Skip logic correctly bypasses VRRW registers without generating errors.

Pre_Conditions:
1. System is powered on.
2. SOFT_RST_REG_ADDRESS is defined as 0x00000000.
3. soft_reset_chk() is inside #ifdef 0 block.
Test_Steps:
1. Verify soft_reset_chk() function is inside #ifdef 0 disabled block.
2. Confirm SOFT_RST_REG_ADDRESS (0x00000000) is not accessed during normal test execution.
3. Run gpio_reg_wr_rd_test and verify no access to address 0x00000000.
Expected_Result: SOFT_RST_REG_ADDRESS is not accessed during test execution. No unintended register access at address 0x00000000.
Pass_Criteria: Test completes without accessing SOFT_RST_REG_ADDRESS. Macro resolution status: unresolved in Header File RAG.
